paragraphs: The “Gift Cards” category is a top-level department in Shopify’s product taxonomy. It brings together the product families assigned to Gift Cards, providing the starting point for classification throughout this branch of the catalog. Its immediate branches include Closed-Loop Gift Cards, Open-Loop Gift Cards.

When describing products in Gift Cards, useful Shopify classification details include Gift card format: Identifies the delivery or physical form in which the gift card is provided; Color: Defines the primary color or pattern, such as blue or striped; Language: Specifies the language used or compatible language, e.g. English, multilingual. These are descriptive comparison points rather than required GitStore category fields; retain the product’s actual characteristics when choosing a category. Where an immediate branch describes the product more precisely, follow that branch and continue to the most appropriate specific category.

The “Closed-Loop Gift Cards” category belongs to Gift Cards. It groups items under the official Shopify classification “Gift Cards > Closed-Loop Gift Cards”, keeping this product family distinct within its parent, Gift Cards. This is a terminal category in this release, so it provides the most specific available placement along this classification path.

Use this placement for products that fit the named category; products serving a different purpose should be classified in the appropriate neighboring branch.
